metadata.note: QEMU-only AUR transitive-closure regression (2026-08-18 incident). This is the GOOD config: plain package names so apply exercises the live resolver, with yay driving the helper path and downgrade as the harmless AUR package. The guest script (guest-aur-closure.sh) derives the BAD config from this file at runtime by adding lib32-gst-libav (whose AUR dep chain ends in the nonexistent lib32-libdav1d) plus a canary repo package, so the tracked config never rots when upstream fixes the PKGBUILD. Disks match vm-day2.json (the image this drives against). NOT for real hardware.
